answer: Each identity lodges one pressed lotus at the public archive, sealed with its plot mark. Auditors at the jetty match each specimen against filed ones. A copied lotus or reused seal burns a 70-credit bond; no two filings share a meadow plot. The k-th identity under one key pays 38+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented lotus fails, its seal naming its home plot; an honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its full share.
